id: \bWhat? It's not easy navigating these waters. I can head back but I'll need time to figure out the path ahead.
en: \bWhat? It's not easy navigating these waters. I can head back but I'll need time to figure out the path ahead.
it: \bChe c'è? Non è facile navigare in queste acque. Posso tornare indietro, ma mi servirà tempo per capire la rotta da seguire.
\bCome vuoi. Così ho tempo per pensare.

id: \bI figured out the way forward. Where are we going?
en: \bI figured out the way forward. Where are we going?

id: \bWell fine. I could use a break.
en: \bWell fine. I could use a break.
it: \bE va bene. Una pausa mi farebbe comodo.

id: You are about to enter a battle with a legendary that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
en: You are about to enter a battle with a legendary that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
it: Stai per affrontare un Pokémon leggendario che, se non lo catturi qui, non sarà ottenibile fino al post-game. Vuoi salvare?

id: \bTabitha: You're too late. Groudon is awake and shrinking the sea. Boss Maxie has done his job. Now it's my job to stop you.
en: \bTabitha: You're too late. Groudon is awake and shrinking the sea. Boss Maxie has done his job. Now it's my job to stop you.
it: \bOttavio: Sei arrivato tardi. Groudon si è risvegliato e sta prosciugando il mare. Il Capo Max ha fatto il suo lavoro. Ora tocca a me fermarti.

id: \bTabitha: This can't be over. Surly Boss Maxie will do something.
en: \bTabitha: This can't be over. Surly Boss Maxie will do something.
it: \bOttavio: Non può finire così. Di sicuro il Capo Max farà qualcosa.

id: \bLance: You've done it. The Pokémon won't be causing trouble like that again anytime soon.
en: \bLance: You've done it. The Pokémon won't be causing trouble like that again anytime soon.
it: \bLance: Ce l'hai fatta. Quei Pokémon non creeranno guai del genere per un bel pezzo.

id: \bAs for Team Aqua and Magma, I think that's the last we'll see of them. With their plans ruined they should be finished.
en: \bAs for Team Aqua and Magma, I think that's the last we'll see of them. With their plans ruined they should be finished.
it: \bQuanto al Team Idro e al Team Magma, credo che non li rivedremo più. Con i loro piani in fumo, dovrebbero essere finiti.
\bLance: Io mi occuperò del Team Idro.

id: \rShelly: You're too late. Kyogre is awake and flooding the land. Boss Archie has done his job. Now it's my job to stop you.
en: \rShelly: You're too late. Kyogre is awake and flooding the land. Boss Archie has done his job. Now it's my job to stop you.
it: \rAda: Sei arrivato tardi. Kyogre si è risvegliato e sta inondando la terra. Il Capo Ivan ha fatto il suo lavoro. Ora tocca a me fermarti.

id: \rShelly: This can't be over. Surely Boss Archie will do something.
en: \rShelly: This can't be over. Surely Boss Archie will do something.
it: \rAda: Non può finire così. Di sicuro il Capo Ivan farà qualcosa.

id: \bLance: \PN, perfect timing. The last time we met we were working together to take down Team Rocket. Well this time there are two teams.
en: \bLance: \PN, perfect timing. The last time we met we were working together to take down Team Rocket.  Well this time there are two teams.
it: \bLance: \PN, tempismo perfetto. L'ultima volta che ci siamo visti abbiamo collaborato per sgominare il Team Rocket.  Beh, stavolta i team sono due.

id: \bI can take on one by myself. I'm going to trust you to handle the other. Do you want Team Magma or Aqua?
en: \bI can take on one by myself. I'm going to trust you to handle the other. Do you want Team Magma or Aqua?
it: \bPosso affrontarne uno da solo. Mi fido di te per occuparti dell'altro. Preferisci il Team Magma o il Team Idro?
\bLance: Io mi occuperò del Team Magma.
